title: Rows versus partitions
prompt: The `error_events` table above has only a few rows. This program spreads it over more partitions. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
hints: `repartition` moves rows between partitions; it never adds or removes rows.
Spark makes the number of partitions you ask for, even if some end up empty.
`master` is the text that says where Spark runs, with the number of cores in brackets.
